criteria.summary: Exactly ## Direction, ## Because and ## Watch, in order, each a list of - lines with no loose text.
Every contract mustContain key (params.keys) is answered once as a - Key: value Direction line.
The source is derived and cites only Director slots and findings: no other agent, URL or note.
Every Because line ends with (<ref>) from the source, and every source ref backs a Because line.
Every Watch line is If <metric> <comparator> <number> <window>, then <action>.
Direction is plain language: no record refs, slot ids, file paths, code markup or placeholders.
Every Direction value is within params.maxWords words and params.maxSentences sentences.
A measure brief states at least params.min quantities: a number, a date, or an explicit zero, none or free.
A profile says what it is not: a Not, Never or Avoid line, or an exclusion.
A release states its Stage, Scope rows <kind> (<pages>): <use case naming the stage>, a Not-in-scope list, at most the contract page cap at an early stage, and derives from the customer need.
